description:
Impact Performance Club has been elevating human performance and impacting lives with high-standard brands with unique partnerships steeped in value, integrity, and trust. Fitness Impact, Impact Cell, Impact Active Events, and Athlete Mind And Me Brands provide the brand strength deployed within the Impact Performance Club. A simple tagline Elevating Human Performance has been utilized to transform hundreds of lives, and we offer our brands with exceptional partnerships to our affiliates to play a significant part in being a Hero in impacting many lives with trusted and proven resources, performance systems and critical playbooks for success inside the Impact Performance Club. 
As an affiliate, you will receive links, discount codes, gift cards, branding tools, and other resources to attract those people in need to your position as a club partner and Hero and our proven systems and dedicated teams so life transformation can begin with a new healthy active lifestyle with visions of goals left behind accomplished.
payout_period: Payments are paid on the 1st of each month.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to Impact Performance Club! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

An affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

An affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code, with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If the customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses the coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise the merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount, which is calculated based on the Commission structure. The commission amount is dependent on order value and does not include extra fees (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in Settings. The payment schedule will be noted on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. The status of the commission is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commission will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotional media, such as a banner, logo, or specific collection promotion, with you through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, an affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also get network commission, which depends on the merchant's settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share the network link, and any other affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, we can't track them, and therefore cannot pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookie Day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at the merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: friends@fitnessimpactonline.com

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions, you can send an email to friends@fitnessimpactonline.com  for support.
